goal: Detect silent semantic merge conflicts across open pull requests automatically
Saves contributors and maintainers from manual rebasing to discover broken merges
agreement: Support for running periodic merge checks within repository CI (maflcko)
Answered objection: a malicious PR could abuse the runner to mark all open PRs as failing (fjahr)
Contended that similar denial of service risks already exist in current automation (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it is a tooling convenience rather than a fix for release integrity or core CI reliability
Helps contributors and maintainers catch broken merge commits before review or merge

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it adds CI orchestration rather than expanding test coverage or test capabilities
Provides earlier signal when master branch updates break tests on open pull requests
